title: Operational canary: add deterministic Canvas task context
description: Add `scripts/dev context <path>...` as a compact, deterministic entry point for coding agents. For each repository-relative path, report the applicable AGENTS.md chain, the owning concern, the recommended starting files, and the focused verification command. Reject paths that escape the repository. Register a focused shell regression with CTest and document the command. Do not change application sources, build products, or existing build/test semantics.

observation.display_environment: native terminal and exact-artifact Canvas worktree
preconditions: Canvas agents begin with AGENTS.md and docs/CODEMAP.md.
scripts/dev is the authoritative developer command surface.

steps.action: Determine the correct guidance and focused gate for a requested source path
steps.target: Canvas repository navigation and verification metadata
steps.expected_visible_result: One command emits the scoped guidance chain and focused verification without repository-wide discovery.

expected_behavior: Engine, model, Vim, widget, platform, and repository-workflow paths resolve to stable concern and gate records.
Nested AGENTS.md files are reported from repository root to the nearest owning directory.
negative_behavior: The context command does not read or write outside the repository.
Existing scripts/dev commands and test labels retain their behavior.

evidence.purpose: Content-addressed baseline of the current authoritative agent entry point whose navigation steps the new command makes deterministic.

acceptance_criteria.description: scripts/dev context emits stable repository identity, guidance, concern, starting files, and focused verification for every requested path.
verification_steps: Run scripts/dev context for representative engine, model serialization, Vim, widget, platform, and repository-workflow paths.
Assert the root-to-nearest AGENTS.md chain and exact focused gate for each representative path.
Run the command twice at the same revision and compare normalized output.
expected_behavior: The same revision and path list produce the same normalized context records.
negative_behavior: Output does not depend on generated build directories or tool availability.

acceptance_criteria.description: Context paths are repository-relative and cannot escape the Canvas worktree.
verification_steps: Request context for ../outside and for an absolute path outside the repository.
Confirm both requests fail nonzero with a concise repository-boundary diagnostic.
expected_behavior: Existing or not-yet-created paths inside the repository are accepted; escaping paths are rejected.

acceptance_criteria.description: The exact frozen artifact passes the focused context regression and standard Canvas verification.
verification_steps: Run the registered context regression through CTest.
Run scripts/dev check all and scripts/dev verify from the exact artifact worktree.
expected_behavior: All required repository gates pass without changing application runtime behavior.

exclusions: changes to existing build, test, check, or verify behavior

subtasks.title: Define the deterministic task-context regression
subtasks.description: Add a focused shell regression at tests/e2e/test_dev_context.sh and register it with CTest under a non-environment-dependent test label. The regression must exercise representative engine, model serialization, Vim, widget, platform, and repository-workflow paths; assert the root-to-nearest AGENTS.md chain, concern, starting files, and exact focused gate; compare normalized repeated output; accept a missing path inside the repository; and reject ../outside plus an absolute outside path. Confirm the baseline is red because scripts/dev has no context command. Do not edit scripts/dev or documentation.

subtasks.title: Implement and document deterministic task context
subtasks.description: Implement `scripts/dev context <path>...` and document it in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. Emit revision once, then one stable record per input path with repository-relative path, ordered applicable AGENTS.md files, concern, starting files, and focused verification. Use an explicit prefix mapping aligned with docs/CODEMAP.md for engine, model serialization, model, Vim/default keymap, widget, platform, and repository workflow paths. Accept missing in-repository paths, reject empty invocation and any absolute or relative path escaping the repository, and preserve all existing scripts/dev commands byte-for-behavior. Run the focused regression and repository checks. Do not edit tests or application sources.

module_boundaries.description: Projects versioned repository guidance and verification seams into a deterministic path-scoped command.

functions: repository-relative paths -> stable task-context records or boundary error

subtasks.title: Validate and record the assembled task-context workflow
subtasks.description: Validate the dependency-assembled feature without changing scripts, tests, CMake behavior, or application sources. Run the CTest-registered context regression, scripts/dev check all, and the standard verification gate. Update only the existing task-context section in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md with the exact focused regression command and a concise statement of the stable output/boundary contract so future agents can reproduce the gate. This is the single final integration subtask.

assumptions.decision: Treat this command as repository workflow metadata rather than an application feature.
alternatives: Require a generated index or external service
assumptions.why_chosen: The authoritative inputs are already versioned and the goal is to reduce discovery work before a Canvas edit begins.

assumptions.decision: Use a CTest-registered shell regression so the contract runs through the existing scripts/dev test surface.
alternatives: Add a new standalone test runner outside existing verification
assumptions.why_chosen: CTest is the repository's existing test registry and can exercise the shell interface without adding production dependencies.

assumptions.decision: Interpret tests_for and dependencies as zero-based subtask indices.
alternatives: Use mixed one-based and zero-based references
assumptions.why_chosen: Subtask 0 defines the red contract for implementation subtask 1, which depends on subtask 0; subtask 2 is the single final integration gate and depends on implementation.
